name: Set-Union Maximization Constraint
description: Replaces the algebraic constraint (product of sums is exactly $3^m$) with a set-theoretic one (the sum of the sizes of memory block unions equals $2000m$). This forces the model to deduce that each union must achieve its maximum possible size of 2000, which only happens when the two nodes are assigned disjoint memory blocks (different tiers). This defeats models that rely on simple algebraic cues like 'XOR 3' or 'sum is 3' to blindly trigger a bipartite graph coloring template.
